fieldStatusKey.message: Only one independent provider supports this value; review before arranging.

steps.meaning: The key in this Song Model was derived from Basic Pitch's 1876 note events by Krumhansl-Kessler profile correlation. It is marked low_confidence with one supporting provider, which is what it is.

steps.step: 7. what the transcription did NOT become

fieldStatusMelody.message: 1876 transcribed event(s) from BASIC_PITCH did not meet the canonical melody threshold; a single transcription provider on a full mix is not a melodic line. Separate a vocal or lead stem first, or configure a second transcription provider.

steps.meaning: No gate was lowered to make this run look better. See 'refusedByDesign' below.

refusedByDesign.what: melodyNotes is 0 even though 1876 note events came back.
refusedByDesign.why: fuseCanonicalNotes admits a lone transcription provider only when note.confidence x result.confidence x providerReliability reaches SOLE_PROVIDER_CONFIDENCE (0.85). Basic Pitch's aggregate confidence on this full mix was 0.473, so no single note can reach the bar, and dense polyphonic clusters additionally trip the ambiguity rule.
refusedByDesign.isThisABug: No. Basic Pitch on a full mix returns every instrument's notes at once. That is a polyphonic transcription of a mix, not a melodic line, and calling it 'the melody' would be false. The gate is doing its job.
refusedByDesign.whatWouldFixItProperly: Separate a vocal or lead stem first (Demucs / BS-RoFormer, neither configured on this machine) and transcribe that, or configure a second independent transcription provider so the two corroborate. Both are capability work, not threshold work.
refusedByDesign.whatWasNotDone: SOLE_PROVIDER_CONFIDENCE was not lowered. No validation, SSRF, auth or licence gate was bypassed or weakened anywhere in this run.

fixesThisRunRequired.problem: The analysis failed at 68% with 'Analysis providers returned an invalid Song Model. Key analysis is required.' — before any transcribed note could be stored.
fixesThisRunRequired.cause: The only key provider is ESSENTIA, which is not configured here. The local spectral key detector returns null on a real mixed recording: drums, bass harmonics and reverb smear the spectrum until no pitch class clears its peak-share and separation thresholds.
fixesThisRunRequired.fix: keyFromNotes.ts — Krumhansl-Kessler profile correlation over the duration-weighted pitch-class distribution of the transcribed notes. It refuses rather than guesses below 12 notes or 4 distinct pitch classes, and its confidence is capped at 0.75 so a dedicated key model always outranks it.

fixesThisRunRequired.problem: With the estimator wired in, the analysis still failed for want of a key.
fixesThisRunRequired.cause: reconcileAnalysisField admits a single observation only when confidence x providerReliability >= 0.32. TRANSCRIPTION_KEY_V1 was absent from the reliability table and took the 0.35 unknown-provider default, so it could never clear the bar.
fixesThisRunRequired.fix: Registered TRANSCRIPTION_KEY_V1 at key: 0.5 — above the local spectral baseline (0.45), because the notes are already found rather than guessed from a smeared spectrum, and well below ESSENTIA (0.82), which is what it must never be mistaken for. The 0.32 admission threshold was not changed.

fixesThisRunRequired.problem: A rejected Song Model discarded every provider result that explained why it was rejected.
fixesThisRunRequired.fix: song_model_rejected now logs the issues, every provider's status and error, the transcription counts, and each key candidate with its confidence. This is what turned 'Key analysis is required' into a diagnosis.

fixesThisRunRequired.problem: The melody field reported 'No transcription provider returned a melodic line' when a provider had returned 1876 events that were refused as canon.
fixesThisRunRequired.fix: The message now says how many events came back, from which provider, why they were refused, and what would fix it.

honestLimits: melodyNotes, bassNotes and chords are all 0. Basic Pitch alone on a full mix cannot fill them, and this run does not pretend otherwise.
The key is low_confidence with a single supporting provider. It is usable evidence, not a verified fact.
bpm 60.6 comes from the local structure fallback, not from a beat tracker; BEAT_THIS and MADMOM are not configured here.
The tunnel is an operator-run Cloudflare quick tunnel with a rotating hostname. It proves reachability; it is not a deployment.
One song. This is a smoke test of a transport and a repair, not a benchmark.
